title: detection-v1
description: Output of floor-plan image detection (Path B): the `detection` object returned by the AI service's POST /process-floor-plan. This is the plug-and-play seam: any detector (the current OpenCV heuristic or a future trained model) emits exactly this shape, and the Node bridge maps it to canvas-v2. All coordinates are in SOURCE-IMAGE pixels (origin top-left, +y downward); no real-world scale is applied here. Mirrors `DetectionResult` in Ai-service/app/schemas.py — keep the two in lockstep.

walls.description: Straight wall segments, each as a centre line between two endpoints (not a bounding box).

rooms.description: Detected room regions. Informational: the converter derives rooms from the walls itself, so these are not required downstream.

doors.description: Door openings. Each is snapped to the nearest wall by the bridge; one farther than OPENING_SNAP_THRESHOLD_PX (60 px) from every wall is dropped.

windows.description: Window openings. Same attachment rule as doors.

points.description: Closed polygon boundary as [x, y] pairs in image pixels (last point is not repeated).

areaPx.description: Polygon area in square image pixels.

opening.description: A door or window. (x, y) is the CENTRE of the opening, which should lie on or near its wall's centre line.

width.description: Opening width along the wall, in image pixels. Defaults: 36 for doors, 48 for windows.

metadata.description: Companion envelope field (`metadata` beside `detection` in the response), not part of the detection object itself. Describes how the result was produced.

method.description: Detector identifier, e.g. "opencv-heuristic" or a model name such as "yolo-v11".
